title: xDrip Ticwatch C2 Blank Watchface
body:
Hi All, 

I am just wondering if anyone else has experienced the following issue.

I have a Ticwatch C2 running WearOS 2.0 + MM + Libre + xDrip build version 31-01-2019. The system works fine with the watch set as the collector 95% of the time. 

My issue is that the watchface will go completely black, no graphs or numbers, intermittently. It has happened a few times in the past couple of weeks, and can only be brought back by restarting the watch. It is a small but annoying issue. When the watchface is black, going to the xDrip settings via the app menu also yields a black screen. It's like the app is not responding, and as WearOS has no option for ANR notifications in the developers options I cannot check that hypothesis.

Anyone else had this?

comments.body: I don't use the C2 as a collector, only to display data from a G6 via the phone, but I have never seen this.

Hello

I have too, a Ticwatch C2 running WearOS 2.0 + MM + Libre + xDrip, but I don't use the C2 as a collector, only to display data from a Libre  via the phone (P20 Pro) But I'm not able to get alerts to the smartwatch.
They sound on the phone, but I do not get any notification to the clock.

Is it necessary for me to put it as standalone or collector  so that the alerts arrive?

please helppp

The solution (working thus far) has been to clear the data and cache of the xDrip app and Watchface app on the watch. Keeping an eye out for any additional dropouts.

As for the notifications on the watch, when I cleared the settings the alert toggles were all turned off. This greatly reduced the draw on the battery of the watch, having about 35% battery at now at 9pm from a day starting at 8.30am off the charger. This is still while running the collector from the watch.

The alert setting may need to be toggled on both the phone and watch for these to work successfully, what combinations have you tried?

Hello

I have Ticwatch S2 running on WearOS 2.0 + MM + Libre + xDrip, and starting from yesterday (4th of the July) the data and graph on the xdrip watchface are deleted. Then I must press the send glucose to watch to see bring back everything to normal.
